brief.name: FitLoop
brief.pitch: FitLoop helps you finish three small daily habits by filling a ring one check-off at a time, with gentle encouragement and no pressure.
mechanics: Check off three small daily habits
A ring fills as habits are completed
Home screen widget for quick check-offs
brief.art_style: Clean, minimal, soft gradients, big rounded numbers
facts: Users check off three small daily habits
Progress is shown as a ring that fills

concepts.audience_note: People who have quit habit apps because the pressure and guilt of missing a day felt worse than the habit was worth. They want a tracker that feels kind.
concepts.angle: Position FitLoop's gentle encouragement as the opposite of nagging habit apps.
concepts.hook_line: A habit app that never scolds you

meta.headline: A habit app that never scolds you
meta.text: Check off three small habits a day and watch a ring fill. Missed one? No guilt here, just a gentle nudge to try again.

tiktok.text: Three small habits a day. One ring to fill. Kind encouragement, never a scolding.
